scripts.deploy:
npx turbo prune @reach/api --out-dir=./out && cp tsconfig.base.json out/ && echo 'shamefully-hoist=true
node-linker=hoisted
enable-pre-post-scripts=true' > out/.npmrc && cd out && vercel deploy --prod --yes

enable-pre-post-scripts=true' > out/.npmrc && cd out && vercel deploy --yes
